title: Charts and the IDE
summary: Ask a chart question, open the answer, read a round-trip trace, jump to RAD Studio
intro: Read this when you first ask a chart question: how to ask one from drag-lint > Reports or a script, where the answer lands, how to read a round-trip trace, and the one-time draglint:// registration that makes a chart row open its line in RAD Studio. Needs a repository clone and PowerShell 7.
